public_payload.normalized_proposition: The vast, vast majority of the world's compute revenue, which he wagers is 70% to 90%, depends on venture capital propping up the AI labs.

statement.excerpt: The vast, vast majority of the world’s compute revenue — I’d wager anywhere from 70% to 90% — is contingent on venture capital propping the AI labs up

from_speaker: contingent on venture capital propping the AI labs up
our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes AI compute rental revenue the intended denominator, although the sentence itself says all compute revenue.
The percentage is an approximate estimate. The firm commitment is that a very large majority depends on continued outside financing of AI labs.
Customer revenue share alone does not establish financing dependence. The assessment requires evidence about what spending could continue without additional financing.
For the ongoing state at publication, use the second quarter of 2026 as the latest completed reporting quarter. Annual projections are context, not realized quarterly revenue.
Venture capital may include strategic private equity investments in the surrounding discussion; debt, customer receipts and existing cash must be identified separately.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable worldwide AI compute revenue data and lab financing records establish that roughly 70–90% of revenue depends on continued outside equity financing, after accounting for customer receipts, existing liquidity and replacement demand.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes that the dependence is substantially below the claimed range and that a very large majority of revenue can continue without further outside equity financing of the labs.
